g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().
g.title: t3 (cooperative): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().

g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).
g.title: t3 (cooperative): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).

g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): z_swap(): arch_swap(). z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> z_swap_irqlock() -> arch_swap() (kswap.h:208, kernel_arch_func.h:87): PENDSVSET (kernel_arch_func.h:94), then irq_unlock(0) (kernel_arch_func.h:97): BASEPRI 0. PendSV has the lowest priority (exception.h:149): each pending interrupt runs first. PendSV will take the cache as it is then (now t2).
g.title: t3 (cooperative): z_swap(): arch_swap(). z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> z_swap_irqlock() -> arch_swap() (kswap.h:208, kernel_arch_func.h:87): PENDSVSET (kernel_arch_func.h:94), then irq_unlock(0) (kernel_arch_func.h:97): BASEPRI 0. PendSV has the lowest priority (exception.h:149): each pending interrupt runs first. PendSV will take the cache as it is then (now t2).

g.data-tip: PendSV: switch. Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). z_arm_pendsv (swap_helper.S:48): BASEPRI raised (swap_helper.S:123). New thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (swap_helper.S:147), _current = t2 (swap_helper.S:149). The BASEPRI of the new thread is restored (swap_helper.S:264).
g.title: PendSV: switch. Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). z_arm_pendsv (swap_helper.S:48): BASEPRI raised (swap_helper.S:123). New thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (swap_helper.S:147), _current = t2 (swap_helper.S:149). The BASEPRI of the new thread is restored (swap_helper.S:264).

g.data-tip: Device ISR: entry. Step 4 of the TLC trace (state 4 -> 5). Exception entry: the device interrupt of the ISR i1 of the model. An ISR that calls the kernel runs only while BASEPRI is 0. The entry does not change BASEPRI.
g.title: Device ISR: entry. Step 4 of the TLC trace (state 4 -> 5). Exception entry: the device interrupt of the ISR i1 of the model. An ISR that calls the kernel runs only while BASEPRI is 0. The entry does not change BASEPRI.

g.data-tip: Device ISR: k_sem_reset(o1). k_sem_reset(o1) (sem.c:161): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:163). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The loop while (z_sched_wake(-EAGAIN)) (sem.c:166, ksched.h:295) wakes all waiters: each one leaves the wait queue, its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value -EAGAIN. Woken: t2, t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t2 is ready and cooperative, so should_preempt() is false (kthread.h:276). cache = _current = t2 (sched.c:175).
g.title: Device ISR: k_sem_reset(o1). k_sem_reset(o1) (sem.c:161): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:163). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The loop while (z_sched_wake(-EAGAIN)) (sem.c:166, ksched.h:295) wakes all waiters: each one leaves the wait queue, its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value -EAGAIN. Woken: t2, t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t2 is ready and cooperative, so should_preempt() is false (kthread.h:276). cache = _current = t2 (sched.c:175).

g.data-tip: Device ISR: z_reschedule(). z_reschedule() (sem.c:176, sched.c:652): resched() is false in an ISR (sched.c:374), so k_spin_unlock() (sched.c:401) writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). The exit of the ISR is the reschedule point.
g.title: Device ISR: z_reschedule(). z_reschedule() (sem.c:176, sched.c:652): resched() is false in an ISR (sched.c:374), so k_spin_unlock() (sched.c:401) writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). The exit of the ISR is the reschedule point.

g.data-tip: Device ISR: exit. z_arm_int_exit() = z_arm_exc_exit() (exc_exit.c:58-59). PendSV is still pending: it runs after this exit and takes the cache as it is then (t2).
g.title: Device ISR: exit. z_arm_int_exit() = z_arm_exc_exit() (exc_exit.c:58-59). PendSV is still pending: it runs after this exit and takes the cache as it is then (t2).

g.data-tip: PendSV: pending. PENDSVSET is set: the PendSV handler runs when no other interrupt runs (lowest priority).
g.title: PendSV: pending. PENDSVSET is set: the PendSV handler runs when no other interrupt runs (lowest priority).

g.data-tip: t1 (preemptible): ready. t1 is ready (Zephyr priority 0) and does not run. Order of becoming ready (readySince): 1.

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): waits on o1 (K_FOREVER). t2 waits (waits on o1), return value preset to -EAGAIN.

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): ready (PendSV pending). t2 is ready and still _current, but it does not run: PendSV is pending.
